title: Chopin, the Poet of the Piano
subtitle: 考点：音乐家 / composer, pianist, classical
passage: Frédéric Chopin was a famous Polish composer and pianist. He was born in Poland in 1810 and began to play the piano when he was very young. He gave his first public concert at the age of eight, and people were surprised by his gift.

When he grew up, Chopin moved to Paris and lived there for most of his life. He wrote mostly for the piano, and his music is full of feeling. Many of his pieces were inspired by Polish folk music and dances. Because his playing was so soft and romantic, people called him the 'poet of the piano'. Today, his classical music is still loved by pianists and music lovers all over the world.
